prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: If I _____ a bird, I would fly to you.

wrong.am: 與現在事實相反的假設，if 子句要用過去式（be 動詞用 were），不是 am。
wrong.will be: if 子句不能用 will，而且這是不真實的假設。

why: 與現在事實相反的假設，if 子句用 were，主句用 would。
tip: 現在不可能的假設，if 後用 were。
say: If I were a bird, I would fly to you.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: If she had left earlier, she _____ the train.

wrong.would catch: 這是與過去事實相反的假設，主句要用 would have + p.p.，不是 would + 原形。
wrong.had caught: had caught 是 if 子句的形式，主句要用 would have caught。

why: 與過去事實相反，if 用 had + p.p.，主句用 would have + p.p.。
tip: 過去假設：had p.p.，would have p.p.。
say: If she had left earlier, she would have caught the train.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: I wish I could speak French.
I wish I can speak French.
I wish I will speak French.
answer: I wish I could speak French.

wish 後面接與現在事實相反的願望，要用過去式 could，不是 can。
wish 後面不能用 will，要用過去式表示不可能實現的願望。

why: I wish + 過去式，表示對現在的遺憾。
tip: I wish 後面用過去式，表示不可能的願望。
say: I wish I could speak French.

prompt: 你現在沒錢，想說「如果我有錢，我就去歐洲」。哪一句最適合？
options: If I had money, I would go to Europe.
If I have money, I would go to Europe.
If I had money, I will go to Europe.
answer: If I had money, I would go to Europe.

現在沒錢是事實，假設要用過去式 had，而非現在式 have。
if 子句是假設用法，主句要搭配 would，不能用 will。

why: 與現在事實相反的假設：if + 過去式，主句 would + 原形。
tip: 現在的假設：if 加過去式，would 加原形。
say: If I had money, I would go to Europe.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: If only I had listened to my mother!
options: 真希望當時我有聽媽媽的話
只要我聽媽媽的話就好了，現在還可以
answer: 真希望當時我有聽媽媽的話

wrong.只要我聽媽媽的話就好了，現在還可以: had listened 是過去完成式，表示已經來不及，不是現在還有機會。
wrong.我有聽媽媽的話: if only 是遺憾的語氣，表示實際上沒有聽。

why: if only + 過去完成式，表示對過去的強烈遺憾。
tip: if only + had p.p. 是對過去的後悔。
say: If only I had listened to my mother!

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: He talks as if he _____ everything.

wrong.will know: as if 後面不能用 will，表示不真實的比喻用過去式。
wrong.has known: has known 是現在完成式，無法表達「好像知道，但其實不是」的假設。

why: as if 後接不符事實的情況，用過去式 knew。
tip: as if 表示不真實，用過去式。
say: He talks as if he knew everything.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: It's time we will go home.

it's time that 後面的子句用過去式表示該做而未做，不用 will。
going 不能單獨當子句動詞，缺少 be 動詞，而且這個句型不是這樣用。

why: It's time + 主詞 + 過去式，表示「該…了」。
tip: It's time 後面的子句用過去式。

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Were it not for your help, I _____ in trouble now.

wrong.will be: Were it not for 是與現在事實相反的假設，主句要用 would，不是 will。
wrong.would have been: now 表示現在，如果用 would have been 會變成過去的假設，時間不一致。

why: Were it not for ... 是假設語氣，now 指現在，所以主句用 would be。
tip: 沒有…的話：Were it not for。
say: Were it not for your help, I would be in trouble now.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: If I were you, I would apologize.
If I were you, I will apologize.
If I am you, I would apologize.
answer: If I were you, I would apologize.

if 子句用 were 是假設語氣，主句要搭配 would，不用 will。
我不可能是你，是與事實相反的假設，if 後要用 were。

why: If I were you 是常見的假設句型，主句用 would。
tip: If I were you 後面搭配 would。
say: If I were you, I would apologize.

prompt: 你因為塞車而遲到，想說「早知道會塞車，我就搭捷運了」。哪一句最適合？
options: If I had known about the traffic, I would have taken the MRT.
If I knew about the traffic, I would took the MRT.
If I had known about the traffic, I would take the MRT.
answer: If I had known about the traffic, I would have taken the MRT.

wrong.If I knew about the traffic, I would too: would 後面要接原形動詞，不能接過去式 took。
wrong.If I had known about the traffic, I woul: 「早知道」說的是過去，主句也要用 would have + p.p.，不是 would take。

why: 與過去事實相反，兩邊都用過去完成的形式。
say: If I had known about the traffic, I would have taken the MRT.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The doctor suggested that he _____ more rest.

wrong.gets: suggest 後面的 that 子句用原形動詞，不隨主詞加 s。
wrong.got: suggest 後面的 that 子句用原形，不用過去式。

why: suggest、insist、demand 等動詞後面的 that 子句，動詞用原形。
tip: suggest that 後面動詞用原形。
say: The doctor suggested that he get more rest.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: I would rather you stayed home.

wrong.我寧願我自己待在家: you stayed 的主詞是你，不是我。
wrong.我希望你昨天待在家: would rather you stayed 說的是現在或未來的期望，過去式只是假設的形式，不是指昨天。

why: would rather + 人 + 過去式，表示希望對方做某事。
tip: would rather 加人加過去式，表示希望。
say: I would rather you stayed home.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: If it _____ rain tomorrow, we would cancel the trip.

wrong.will: if 子句不用 will，而且主句用 would，所以也要搭配假設形式。
wrong.may: if 子句不用 may 表示假設，語氣和結構都不符。

why: If ... should 表示萬一，可能性很低，主句用 would。
say: If it should rain tomorrow, we would cancel the trip.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Without your advice, I would have made a big mistake.
Without your advice, I will make a big mistake.
Without your advice, I had made a big mistake.
answer: Without your advice, I would have made a big mistake.

wrong.Without your advice, I will make a big m: Without 在這裡表示過去沒有你的建議，是假設，主句要用 would have + p.p.。
wrong.Without your advice, I had made a big mi: had made 是過去完成式，但在這個假設句中需要 would have made。

why: Without 相當於 If it had not been for，主句用 would have + p.p.。
tip: Without 可以代替 if 假設子句。
say: Without your advice, I would have made a big mistake.
